title: Setting-generator intervention response

candidate_model.interpretation: Independent fair-randomizer admixture in each setting device, while holding the source-side conditional response fixed.

interpretation_limits: The intervention family is an explicit new modelling assumption.
It is not uniquely implied by the PHYS-05 statistical factorisation.
No physical implementation of Omega or the intervention has yet been specified.
Predicted curves are conditional on holding P(Lambda|Omega) fixed during setting-device randomization.
No experimental data have been fitted in this stage.
